hero.title: Youth as artists, authors, planners and campaigners — not just participants.
hero.subtitle: AFT is a nonprofit global youth arts organization. Young people explore environmental and social issues through art, then develop their work into exhibitions, publishing, performances, films, products and donation campaigns.

mission.title: Art that doesn't stop at the canvas.
mission.body: AFT connects young people's creativity to real social participation. Members don't just submit artwork — they research issues, form teams, run events, publish books and turn art into products and donations.

teams.title: Youth run the projects, not just make the art.

media.body: Plan intro films, shoot scenes, produce interviews and promo content.

event.body: Design exhibition flow, run visitor programs and campaigns, host on-site.

editing.body: Edit youth work and writing, build picture books, archive the project.

host.body: MC events and present the meaning of the work to visitors.
